---
title: Mozzarella in Carrozza
id: MAR-0050
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 30
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 8 slices of sandwich bread
- 300 g of mozzarella
- 2 eggs
- to taste milk
- to taste breadcrumbs
- to taste frying oil
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Moisten the bread slices with a little milk.
2. Slice the mozzarella and place it on 4 slices of bread, without letting it overhang.
3. Cover with the remaining bread slices, pressing them lightly.
4. Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
5. Gently dip the prepared sandwiches in the eggs, then in the breadcrumbs, pressing them with the palm of your hand.
6. Fry the sandwiches in hot oil, turning them once with a suitable spatula.
7. Drain them, place them on kitchen paper towels, and pat them dry with paper towels.
